title: In one consultant's experience, Entra's passkey campaign lets SMS users register synced passkeys their policy bars
note: The briefing documents a practitioner-reported Entra registration-policy mismatch that may allow SMS or voice users to enroll synced passkeys where tenant policy intends to permit only device-bound passkeys.

title: Semperis Researcher Discovers an Iranian Nation-State-Sponsored Threat Group Operating Command-and-Control Infrastructure in the United States
note: New Semperis research details Prince of Persia infrastructure, stealth techniques and indicators relevant to identity-resilience and hybrid-environment defenders.

title: Ory Hydra, Ory Kratos, Ory Keto, Ory Oathkeeper v26.4.6 released
note: The release addresses a Go certificate-verification issue, adds brute-force protection and changes UAE PASS account-linking identity handling from upstream subject values to UUIDs.

title: AI-driven, large-scale nation-state campaign using ARTEX enables supply chain compromise
note: Primary threat research attributes the ConnectWise downstream compromise to automated password spraying and OAuth-application abuse, including credential planting for persistence and Microsoft Graph data access.

title: Zeabur's Second Breach Ran on Keys the First Rotation Missed
note: Analyzes how stale plaintext admin tokens, unrotated cloud credentials, root passwords, and an overprivileged maintenance credential contributed to Zeabur's second breach.

title: Why MFA Did Not Save Microsoft 365 Tenants from the ConnectWise Attack
note: This independent analysis explains how a compromised application identity bypassed user-centric MFA assumptions and exploited broad directory permissions across downstream tenants.

title: Contained: Oct 21, 2026 LiteLLM release v1.107.0 Compromised
note: The maintainer’s incident disclosure records the malicious release, credential exposure paths and containment actions for an AI infrastructure component that aggregates high-value provider secrets.

title: BeyondTrust AI Agent Security Now Generally Available
note: A meaningful PAM move that distinguishes agent actions from human actions and applies runtime privilege policy, JIT escalation, and approval to endpoint-based AI agents.

title: Security Disclosure: Wednesday October 21st
note: Railway’s disclosure warns that decrypted environment variables may have been accessed, requiring broad rotation of API keys, database credentials, registry credentials and related service secrets.

title: Mission-Bound Authorization for OAuth 2.0
note: This new OAuth draft proposes a durable, revocable mission object binding an approved task to delegated authority and downstream token issuance for agent workflows.

title: Phantom Labs Research Shows AI Agents Are Acting Beyond Intent. BeyondTrust AI Agent Security, Now Available, Stops Them
note: BeyondTrust reports runtime telemetry on agent commands, MCP connections and poisoned skills while announcing general availability of agent-specific privilege enforcement on Windows and macOS.

title: NVIDIA Launches OpenShell Reference Architecture for Safe AI Agents
note: The reference architecture combines agent isolation, policy enforcement, continuous monitoring and hardware-backed containment for enterprise and edge agent workloads.

title: Delinea Fastpath Launches MCP Server for AI-Powered Access Governance and Audit Readiness
note: Shows how access-review, SoD, and audit data are being exposed to AI assistants while retaining governance context and remediation workflows.

title: SentinelOne Launches Singularity Agentic Detection and Response to Stop Rogue and Malicious AI Agents at Machine Speed
note: A meaningful platform move toward discovering agents, governing their actions, monitoring behavior and stopping unintended or malicious activity at runtime.

title: Authenticate 2026 Day 3: Trusting the transaction in the agentic economy
note: Summarizes FIDO's latest agentic-transaction focus on verified human approval, traceability, and enforcing limits on actions taken by delegated agents.

title: Zeabur shutting down after second security breach in two months
note: A material identity-control failure involving plaintext internal credentials, unrotated administrator tokens, exposed cloud access keys, SSH-key persistence and root access across GCP servers.

title: Active Exploitation of May 2026 PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257 (Updated October 20
note: Unit 42 reports ransomware operators exploiting a GlobalProtect authentication bypass to establish VPN sessions while bypassing MFA, then pivoting toward lateral movement and offline domain-credential theft.

title: Protecting Chrome and Android Users from Compromised eMudhra Intermediate CA Certificates
note: Primary technical disclosure explains how weak intermediate-CA private keys could enable trusted-site impersonation, credential interception and session hijacking, and documents Chrome’s emergency response.

title: Palo Alto’s firewall OS has been under attack from multiple ransomware groups since June
note: Reporting on Unit 42’s update describes Qilin and INC exploitation of a PAN-OS GlobalProtect authentication bypass to establish VPN sessions while bypassing MFA.

title: FIDO Alliance Moves to Accelerate Digital Credentials Adoption at Scale
note: Announces public digital-wallet certification work and verifier-identification mechanisms aimed at making credential presentation, agentic commerce, and human approval more interoperable and phishing-resistant.

title: Securing AI Agents with Auth0 CIMD and Token Exchange
note: Provides a concrete implementation pattern for preserving the user-to-agent delegation chain across multi-hop agent calls while enforcing permission ceilings and short-lived delegated tokens.

title: Andromeda October 2026 Security Incident
note: Andromeda confirms unauthorized access to credentials affecting a limited number of customer accounts, key rotation and an ongoing root-cause investigation.

title: Amazon WorkSpaces simplifies secure AI agent access to enterprise cloud desktops with less infrastructure to operate and manage
note: AWS now brokers AI-agent WorkSpaces sessions through OAuth 2.0 and manages connection lifecycles, while exposing session state and observability without handing agents the underlying streaming connection.

title: FIDO Alliance Moves to Accelerate Digital Credentials Adoption at Scale
note: FIDO announced public working documents for wallet certification and verifier identification, relevant to interoperable credentials, phishing-resistant recovery and trusted agent delegation.

title: ConnectWise Cloud Backup application abused in cross-tenant token sweep
note: A compromised vendor-held application credential was used to request app-only Microsoft Graph tokens across consenting Microsoft 365 tenants without passwords or MFA, demonstrating multi-tenant service-principal blast radius.

title: ConnectWise backup credentials exposed multiple Microsoft 365 tenants
note: The incident shows how a compromised application credential authenticated into customer tenants without interactive MFA, obtained Graph access and reportedly escalated application privileges.

title: Intent Token
note: A new standards-track proposal for carrying signed, auditable user intent into later OAuth authorization decisions instead of letting agents translate natural-language goals directly into broad scopes.

title: Agents are your newest insiders. Security must move at their speed.
note: Microsoft describes expanded Entra Agent ID patterns, local-agent discovery, dynamic permissions, and risk-adaptive containment for agents that must not inherit standing human privilege.

title: Authenticate U.S. 2026
note: The current Authenticate U.S. program is a useful primary-community queue anchor for developments in passkey deployment, phishing-resistant authentication, identity proofing and federation practice.

title: Hackers breach Microsoft 365 tenants via ConnectWise supply-chain attack
note: Explains how compromised ConnectWise service-principal credentials enabled direct app authentication, broad tenant access, and MFA bypass across customer Microsoft 365 environments.

title: ConnectWise (SkyKick Vendor Credentials Abused in M365 Attacks
note: The investigation documents a compromised vendor application secret being used across Microsoft 365 tenants, including self-assigned Global Administrator privileges and persistence through added application credentials.

title: CISA Urges Patching Critical Vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support
note: CISA confirms active exploitation of a BeyondTrust Remote Support authentication-bypass vulnerability and directs organizations to investigate privileged sessions, stored credentials, MFA changes and persistence.

title: BeyondTrust patches zero-day exploited in attacks since August
note: Mandiant says attackers exploited an authentication bypass in BeyondTrust Remote Support, escalated to root, accessed stored or brokered credentials, and laterally moved with compromised administrator accounts.

title: An AI agent's own trail can't show what it skipped; the gateway's can
note: This analysis argues that agent-generated audit records cannot prove omitted actions, making gateway- or resource-side logging and authorization evidence essential for agent oversight.

title: ARMORY CASTLE and BT26-05: What Security Teams Need to Know
note: BeyondTrust discloses a zero-day in Remote Support exploited by a suspected China-nexus actor to escalate privileges, extract brokered credentials, establish persistence and evade logging.

title: ARMORY CASTLE Exploits BeyondTrust
note: Primary technical analysis of a BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day used to obtain root access, extract vaulted credentials, alter administrator permissions, and pivot into downstream systems.

title: BT26-05
note: Primary advisory for CVE-2026-102764, a critical unauthenticated Remote Support flaw exploited in the wild and requiring patching plus compromise assessment.

title: Passkey Index 2026
note: New cross-service data shows passkeys reached 36% of successful sign-ins, with higher success rates and lower phishing exposure than traditional MFA.

title: AI-Powered Espionage Campaign Targets Government Linux Infrastructure
note: Primary research documents an AI-assisted intrusion campaign combining credential harvesting, mailbox targeting, web shells, persistence and anti-forensics against government infrastructure.

title: Introducing Descope Agentic Identity Hub 3.0: Governance and Control for AI Agents
note: Material agent-identity release adding approval and review workflows, runtime policy enforcement, workload identity, Agent SSO, private_key_jwt, mTLS, certificate-bound tokens, and DPoP.

title: 7 Billion Passkeys and Counting: The Next Chapter of Passwordless Authentication
note: The 2026 Passkey Index reports an estimated seven billion passkeys and introduces a practical deployment rubric focused on adoption, UX, recovery, and eliminating password fallbacks.

title: Descope Unveils Agentic Identity Hub 3.0 to Enhance Governance and Control for AI Agents
note: Descope’s release adds internal-agent governance, MCP gateway integrations, ID-JAG issuance, ownership, runtime policy enforcement, and audit trails for agents otherwise using shared long-lived credentials.

title: AWS Security Agent (now part of AWS Continuum exploited 33 of 37 new real-world CVEs
note: AWS reports an audited autonomous agent achieving end-to-end exploitation of 33 recent CVEs, including broken authorization, default-credential and admin-cookie attack paths.

title: Proof Launches x401, Giving AI Agents A Way to Prove Who They Represent - and What They're Authorized To Do
note: A notable proposal for binding agent actions to verifiable human identity and signed transaction terms rather than treating possession of a password, OAuth token, or API key as sufficient authority.

source: Microsoft Threat Intelligence and Digital Crimes Unit
title: The hidden network: Inside the phishing infrastructure ecosystem powering global cybercrime
note: Microsoft details YAM Store’s sale of compromised or fraudulently obtained Microsoft and Google environments, accounts, licenses, and storage supporting phishing kits that sent more than one billion messages.

title: Connected App & External Client App Security Requirement Updates
note: Production enforcement on November 4 limits refresh-token idle lifetime to 30 days and begins a broader retirement path for legacy OAuth flows and connected apps.

title: BeyondTrust And AWS: AWS IAM Account Access Manager Support in Identity Security Insights
note: The launch integrates AWS IAM Account Access Manager assignments with effective-permission and identity graphs to expose role chaining, cross-account reach and access to sensitive agents and resources.

title: An OAuth draft for AI agents' step-up login finishes the one-time-code path but leaves passkeys unfinished
note: The review examines an expired individual IETF draft that relays step-up challenges through MCP elicitation, while leaving WebAuthn/passkey delivery and security considerations incomplete.

title: The State of Agentic AI and API Security 2H 2026: Agents Are Acting. Most Organizations Cannot Stop Them.
note: New research finds widespread unauthorized agent actions, shadow or misconfigured MCP infrastructure, and limited ability to contain misbehaving agents before irreversible actions.

title: Meta Says Hackers Took Code, Personal Data of 1,500 in GitHub Breach
note: Meta said attackers accessed GitHub repositories using an employee's stolen credentials, exposing business code and limited personal data before secrets were rotated.

title: Insecure Default File Permissions in Okta RADIUS Agent Windows Installer CVE-2026-78632 - Oct 13, 2026
note: The advisory identifies local service-account access to the RADIUS agent’s AES key and encrypted Okta API token through insecure installer permissions.

title: Hackers turn business backup servers into crypto mines after sneaking malware disguised as Microsoft Edge
note: Reporting on exploitation of AhsayCBS flaws, including an authentication bypass where a random token could substitute for valid credentials before attackers deployed webshells and cryptomining malware.

title: Improper Input Validation in the Okta Credential Provider for Windows CVE-2026-78628 - Oct 13, 2026
note: The Windows credential provider flaw can expose adjacent process memory and affects authentication infrastructure on locally accessible hosts.

title: OIDF publishes threat model for cross-boundary AI agents
note: The AIIM community group’s protocol-agnostic threat model catalogs identity, trust, scope translation, credential capture, and revocation failures when agents cross security boundaries.

title: Docker Hub security advisory: personal access tokens transferred during account-to-organization conversions
note: A critical privilege-assignment flaw allowed an attacker-controlled PAT to authenticate as another user and potentially push, pull, or delete images within that user's scope.

title: Customer Notice: Password Interceptor for Microsoft Active Directory - Upcoming Encryption Mode Change
note: SailPoint is making site-specific encryption keys the only supported protection for Password Interceptor service credentials stored in Active Directory, with migration implications for domain controllers.

title: Intercede Launches MyID Authenticate Passkey Solution
note: MyID Authenticate extends FIDO passkey sign-in to Windows desktops, offline logon, VPNs, legacy applications, and hybrid Entra-connected environments.

title: Resolving the AI Agent Identity Crisis: Many Standards, One Direction
note: A useful technical map of emerging agent-identity work across WIMSE, SPIFFE, OAuth, OpenID, ODIS, CoSAI and NIST, with practical emphasis on short-lived tokens, zero standing privilege and human step-up approval.

title: Extortion via OAuth Application
note: A concrete cloud-extortion case shows a stolen OAuth client secret enabling app-only Entra access, tenant-wide Graph and SharePoint activity, data theft and file deletion without a compromised user or MFA challenge.

source: The New Stack / The Next Web
title: Zenity says one prompt took over every AgentCore agent in an AWS account
note: Zenity’s research and AWS’s response highlight the blast-radius risk of default or broadly delegated AgentCore roles, including cross-agent access to chats, code, and secrets.

title: OpenID Connect Ephemeral Subject Identifier 1.0 Final Specification Approved
note: OIDF approved the final OpenID Connect Ephemeral Subject Identifier specification, a material federation and identifier-privacy standardization milestone.
